description: Implement the complete 150-area, 6-arc King Leo story (from /Users/avian/Desktop/story) inside the existing Jelly Garden Unity match-3 game, preserving every existing animation, particle effect and VFX. Story data (arc1-6.json, 150 areas / 807 repair tasks / 1209 stars) is already authored and only needs a runtime, a meta layer, generated level content, a 150-node map and narrative presentation.

hardRules: NEVER delete, rename or restructure existing prefabs, particle systems, Animator controllers, Animation clips or VFX. Additive changes only.
NEVER modify the match-3 board simulation in LevelManager.cs/Item.cs/Square.cs beyond additive hooks.
Every new .asset/.prefab/.png written by a tool MUST get a matching .meta file with a fresh deterministic GUID.
Every generated file must be reproducible by re-running its generator script in tools/.
No story logic may hardcode an area id. All behaviour comes from Resources/Story/*.json.
